data.name: Eldin
data.gender_notes: Eldin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Eldos', meaning 'old' or 'ancient'. In Greek mythology, Eldin was a name for various gods, particularly those associated with the earth and underworld. In Christianity, the name Eldin may symbolize faith, strength, and a deep connection to spiritual traditions. The name Eldin carries the meaning “Old, powerful god” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eldin usually hope their child will grow to embody old, powerful god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eldin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
